claims.claim: Instrument 01 uses a portable orchestration control plane plus bounded specialist research modules rather than one undifferentiated prompt.
Instrument 01 uses functional public module names while technical IDs and slash-command aliases remain unchanged for compatibility.
Rigilum is presented as a working pre-product identity rather than as a legally cleared corporate, trademark, or domain name.

Adapt uses the stable foil technical namespace to model competing explanations for observed performance and supply task-relevant complementary methods without treating a single error as a stable weakness.
Human authority governs voluntary goals and actions while evidence and proof determine factual warrant.
Mechanical and specification validation do not establish behavioral efficacy of the complete system.
Assure uses the stable infinity-gauntlet technical namespace and does not require private project hooks or hard-coded local runtime paths; missing optional machinery is treated as unavailable.
Instrument 01 is presented as a free MIT-licensed pre-product research-software preview rather than a hosted commercial service.
The repository provides machine-readable citation metadata and an MIT open-source license.
The public surfaces expose documented mechanical validation commands and separate their interpretation from behavioral-efficacy claims.
